description: Smooth-grained hide of a young cow, traditionally common for covering. Cockerell records that modern vegetable-tanned calf had grown unreliable, often pared too thin and prone to becoming hard and brittle, and he advised against its use until tanning practice improved.
name: calf

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
